objections: Keeping all categories leaves a near-unique Art. 9 outcome: the smallest category has share 0.0004 (about 8 of 20000 rows, most likely 'died'). An ED death is the kind of event that appears in news_clips_health, and with age, sex, municipality and arrival week it can single out and confirm a person.

generalize_category_rare@minGroup=10 is valid and merges only that tiny group. It keeps home, admitted_ward, icu, transfer, left_without_being_seen and cancelled_duplicate, which are what visit cleaning, length of stay and revisit analysis need, so the utility loss is negligible.
